g.text: OUTLINE / PRELIMINARY ENGINEERING — dimensions in mm; no general manufacturing tolerance assigned
D03 | Revision A | 25 October 2026 | A3 landscape
Source: frozen ACR1 native geometry and paired BOM/verification. Do not scale; stated dimensions govern.
Cell centers Y = ±250; feed stroke 250 in 40 s (study).
Guides Ø10; span 330. Screw Ø10, lead 2, study root Ø7.4.
South guide Y = -435 to -105; front journal -120 to -100.
Lift docking floor Z = 46; highest floor 830 → travel 784.
Twin screw nominal Ø16, lead 4; study root Ø11.
Reference gearbox ratio 19.8; maximum lift time 120 s.
Reference actuator envelopes do not define supplier flanges.
